acquisition_process.title: Laser ablation and confocal imaging protocol
acquisition_process.protocol_description:
(1)	Prepare STELLARIS 8 Multiphoton for use [set lasers (for GFP-488); objectives - 40× glycerol immersion objective; image size - x: 242.28 µm, y: 120.94 µm, Z: 19.00 µm; zoom - 1.2; scan mode – xyz; pixel dwell - 1.02 µs; pinhole, 67.9 µm. laser power was set to 2% for AOS::NLS-3xVenus and ACS6::NLS-3xVenus; laser power was set to 4.5% for JAZ10::NLS-3xVenus. Fluorescence signals for yellow fluorescent protein (YFP) (excitation 515 nm, emission 525-560 nm) and propidium iodide (excitation 520 nm, emission 590 nm) were detected. 
(2)	Using FRAP (fluorescence recovery after photobleaching) mode, go to set up window, in this mode change the scan mode to xyt, change the MFP to SP667. The rest will be kept as in (1). 
(3)	Adding a new laser, (800 nm), turn on the MP1 shutter, keep the intensity as 0. 
(4)	Move to the FRAP mode, bleach window, setting the laser power 20-25% . Select the ROI (target region for ablation) in this window. 
(5)	Move to the FRAP mode, time course window, in this window, set up as 1 repetition, 2 pre-bleach, 5 bleach, and 2 post-bleach. 
(6)	Move back to FRAP mode, change back to the Stellaris 8 mode for normal confocal imaging, and take the image immediately after ablation as time 0. Settings as (1).
acquisition_process.imaging_instrument_description: STELLARIS 8 Multiphoton/Confocal Microscope from Leica Microsystems coupled with a Mai Tai Multiphoton laser.

imaging_preparation_protocol.title: sample preparation
imaging_preparation_protocol.protocol_description:
(1)	prepare a sterilized chambered cover glass (Nunc™ Lab-Tek™ II Chambered Coverglass, ThermoFisher), put 10µl drops of propidium iodide (15 mg/µl) if needed on the cover glass and later the seedlings will mount on the cover glass on top of the drops to keep the seedlings in good condition not to be dehydrated. 
(2)	From the block of media cut off a 2x1x0.5cm ½ MS media containing 0.9% agar medium with or without the indicated chemicals (for example in ACC experiment, the medium is supplied with 1µM ACC) and submerged the medium into PI staining dye if needed. 
(3)	Transfer 10-15 seedlings inside the chamber, roots of individual seedlings must not overlap. Cover seedlings with the remaining block of media. Close with the chambered cover glass lid.

growth_protocol.title: sample preparation
growth_protocol.protocol_description: Seeds of Arabidopsis were placed on ½ MS (Murashige and Skoog) agar plates. The seeds were stratified for 2 days at 4°C. Seedlings were grown on vertically oriented plates in growth chambers at 150μmol photons m-2 s-1, 22°C under a 16-h light/8-h dark regime. Mutant and wild-type plants were grown in soil at 22°C with a photoperiod of 16-h light and 8-h dark and 65% relative humidity. We use five-day-old seedlings for our experiments.

imaging_preparation_protocol.title: Plankton filtration and concentration
imaging_preparation_protocol.protocol_description:
The environmental plankton samples have been collected onboard local boats or the schooner Tara by surface net tows and filtered through a stack of metal sieves with mesh sizes indicated in the respective datasets (see sampling protocols at BIOcean5D sampling Handbook [2]).
Upon arrival on shore the samples have been directly processed in EMBL's Advanced Mobile Laboratory. The samples were concentrated 1-100x on 1.2 µm MCE membranes by manual pumping and gently keeping cells in solution by pipetting up and down with a Pasteur pipette until a suitable cell density for microscopy was reached. 200 µl of each sample were incubated with Hoechst33324 (#62249, Thermo Fischer) at a final concentration of 2 µM, or with Calcofluor-White stain (CFW, 1:100, #18909, Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min. In the meantime 10 well-glass bottom dishes (Greiner #543079) were coated with Poly-L-Lysine solution (0.005 %, Sigma-Aldrich, P4832) for 10 min and once washed with milliQ water. Each sample was applied into a different well and imaged on a Zeiss LSM900 Laser scanning confocal microscope equipped with Plan-APOCHROMAT 20x/0,8 objective within 4 h post sampling.

CZI files were converted to OME-Zarr with EuBI-Bridge [5]. The image metadata including the curated Channel information was written into the File list, OME-XML and OMERO metadata of the OME-Zarr files. OME-Zarr files were compressed as ZIP. CZI image acquisition metadata was extracted into TSV files with the same names as the corresponding CZI files. Warning: the Channel information is not correct in CZI metadata, the correct Channel information is in OME-XML and OMERO metadata, as well as in the File List.

imaging_preparation_protocol.title: Samples
imaging_preparation_protocol.protocol_description: HeLa cells were grown on PLL-PEG-RGD functionalized round (25 mm in diameter) glass coverslips for 3 days. Coverslips were mounted into holders and cells were cooled to room temperature in live cell imaging solution (Invitrogen) for 15 min prior to measurements. 2 nM anti-HER2 nanobody were added 10 min prior to measurements. For stimulated samples, ligands were added in a concentration of 20 nM after measuring the first 5 cells in resting state.
